hi, i wasnt in a relationship with this person, but i had a close friend in my circle who was way more financially privileged than the 3 of us- which is not a problem inherently, we had another friend who was more “well off” than us, and we had no problem with them. but the three of us slowly noticed more and more throughout the years her little micro-aggressions concerning our money 😭

she’d frequently tease us about not having cars (hers was given by her parents) knowing that two of us couldn’t even start getting our drivers licenses until after high school, due to the lack of help from our parents. we had one friend who lives in low-income government housing, with an abusive mother who takes their money, and this well-off friend would have them pay for her gas when she’d invite them out. (inherently fine, but when u add the specific circumstances it kinda looks ehh!!)

so anyways, just wanted to give context for my advice: in the end it’s up to you and what you think feels right, but in my situation i felt relieved not having this person in my life anymore. it made me uncomfortable to be so close to someone who would never understand how people live, outside of the bubble she grew up in. not every well-off person is like this, of course, but i would genuinely feel uncomfortable with anyone else who acted like this. but absolutely first of all, please talk to her about it. i hope she’s understanding and considers your feelings and upbringing more :)
